customer: On a fast descent today my fork made a loud cracking noise and now the front end wobbles when I brake. It's probably nothing, right? What should I check?
reply: Hi Ash, that does sound unsettling. It is often just the headset working loose. Check the two bolts on the side of the stem are tight, then hold the front brake and rock the bike forwards and backwards. If you feel a knock, tighten the top cap a quarter turn and try again. That sorts it in most cases.
